title: The Two-Person Puzzle Missing a Friend
youtube_title: The Two-Person Puzzle Missing a Friend | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Pilar is just outside the fun, close to a puzzle that was more fun with the friend who had just arrived. Tamsin changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Pilar has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
